about: Hardware checks a stable release needs (ops/ship/hwgate.py). Code merges never wait for them. A capability applies when one of its `present` probes matches the commit: a file glob, then a regex searched in each matching file. Every `require` check of an applying capability needs a `pass` for that build. A pull request that adds or changes a device capability, or a device-side file, updates this file in the same pull request.

checks.shared-receiver: Keyboard and mouse on one Bolt receiver: both found; a remapped key works during a mouse gesture.
checks.mixed-connections: Keyboard on Bluetooth with the mouse on Bolt, then both on Bluetooth: both found, remapped keys work.
checks.service-stop-restores-keys: Remap a key, then stop the user service: the key does its own function again.
checks.crash-recovery: Kill the app with SIGKILL while a key is remapped: key state noted; restart recovers it; state after a keyboard power cycle noted.
checks.easy-switch-away: Press the keyboard's Easy-Switch key to a computer without MX Options while a key is remapped: note whether the key works natively there or is dead.
checks.sleep-wake: Sleep and wake the computer: remapped keys work again.
checks.receiver-replug: Unplug and replug the receiver with both devices on it: both found again, remapped keys work.
checks.keyboard-battery: Keyboard battery level shown; the low-battery notice appears.
checks.top-row-fn-modes: Fn+Esc in both modes: note which control IDs a remapped top-row key reports.
checks.bluetooth-zero-id-access: Keyboard attached over Bluetooth with a zero product ID: note the access result; no udev rule change.
checks.shared-receiver-mouse-latency: Mouse request latency while the keyboard is probed on a shared receiver, measured from the debug log.
checks.keyboard-identity: Keyboard identity read with a non-zero unit ID; same over Bolt and Bluetooth and after a power cycle; differs between two units when two are available. Identifiers stay in private notes, never in the evidence record.
checks.mouse-follows-keyboard: Mouse-follows-keyboard on, press the keyboard's Easy-Switch key: the mouse moves to the same computer; latency noted; mouse-in-deep-sleep case noted; three-computer case.
checks.keyboard-follow-held-key-check: Keyboard follows the mouse over Flow: with no key held it follows; holding Shift, a letter key, or a media key not set to an app action, it stays; each direction and connection noted.
checks.keyboard-follow-held-key-at-switch: Hold a key physically during an Easy-Switch: note what the old and the new computer see.
checks.keyboard-follow-two-computers: Two Linux computers paired over Flow: the keyboard follows the mouse both ways, keys given back before the switch, no dead keys, 40 crossings in one session.
checks.app-profiles-desktops: Keyboard app profiles change keys for the app in front on KDE Wayland, X11, sway and Hyprland; GNOME shows the not-available message.
checks.fn-lock-setting: Toggle the Fn lock switch: the top row flips. The keyboard's own Fn-lock shortcut: the switch follows within a second. Easy-Switch away and back: setting kept per channel as the keyboard keeps it. Power cycle: kept. Toggle while holding F5 with the mouse, then release: no stuck key.
checks.disable-keys-setting: Disable and enable each advertised key; rapid changes preserve both choices. Check power cycle, a native modifier held during change, and a remapped key. Restore earlier disable setting first, then press and release any stuck modifier on original computer.
checks.os-layout-setting: Change layout on current channel and read it back; check keyboard shortcut, remapped keys and a held native modifier. Restore earlier layout first, then press and release affected modifier on original computer. Record other-channel behavior when available.
checks.backlight-settings: Exercise every enabled backlight control and each timer; read-only or unsupported controls stay disabled. Check keyboard brightness keys and notices, own-change suppression, power cycle and preserved settings. Record unsupported controls without claiming them implemented.
checks.backlight-effect-ids-observed: Choose each backlight effect with the keyboard's own effect key and run tools/hidpp_probe.py --json after each: the effect byte read back equals the ID this build names for the effect the keyboard shows, for every effect, the same over two full cycles. Any mismatch is a fail; effects then stay a hint.
checks.lock-key-notices: Turn lock-key notices on: Caps Lock and Num Lock toggles show the right notice; off shows nothing.
checks.mouse-haptic-battery-saving: Haptic battery saving on: at 10 % mouse charge or below, button, gesture, ring, wheel, Flow and API vibrations stay still; above 10 % they play again. Switch off: they play at any charge. Same after the mouse reconnects.
checks.mouse-low-battery-notice: Mouse charge runs down to the low level while discharging: one on-screen notice; another only after it was charged in between. The keyboard notice still works.
checks.screen-switch-haptic: Screen-switch haptics on, two monitors, KDE Plasma Wayland and X11: one tick each time the pointer moves onto the other screen, none while it stays on one, none when off; plugging a monitor in or out gives no extra tick; battery saving keeps it still.
checks.mouse-app-profiles-desktops: Mouse profile for one app with its own buttons, Actions Ring, thumb-wheel function, thumb-wheel keystrokes and gestures: each applies only while that app is in front on KDE Wayland, X11, sway and Hyprland; other apps keep the global settings; GNOME Wayland shows the not-available message; switching app or turning the mouse off mid-action leaves no key or button held.
checks.app-suggestions-linux: Suggested settings on Linux fill only buttons and wheel that still do as in all apps; Zoom desktop meeting window, US layout: back toggles mute once per press, also on long hold, forward toggles video once; Teams, Photoshop and Premiere are not offered.
checks.pan-zoom: Gesture button set to Pan: page follows the hand on both axes, pointer still, release stops at once; speed and Reverse change it. Zoom: up zooms in, steady steps, no Ctrl left held after release. Press without moving runs the tap action. Mid-pan app switch or mouse off: nothing stuck. Middle button with Pan works the same. Practice mode draws without scrolling.
checks.spotlight-effects-desktops: Spotlight button: Highlight, Digital Laser and Still Magnify on hold and release on KDE X11, KDE Wayland, sway, GNOME Wayland and GNOME X11; double-click-hold as documented; Still Magnify on X11 at scale 1, 2 and fractional; a session without Magnify says so; no click is left swallowed after release.
checks.thumbwheel-keystrokes: Thumb-wheel function Custom keystrokes, turning up ] and down [ in an image editor: brush size steps; Reverse swaps them; a fast flick sends no steps after the wheel stops; with Shift held on the keyboard, up sends Shift+]; after release no key stays down.
checks.macro-stop-on-press: Macro with stop-on-press on a mouse button and on a keyboard key: a second press stops it at once and leaves no key or button down; with the option off a second press runs as before.
checks.macro-file-dialogs: Export a macro to a file and import it through the desktop's own file dialogs on KDE and GNOME: the editor shows the imported steps before anything is saved; cancel changes nothing.
checks.flow-peer-pause: Two Linux computers paired over Flow: pause one: the pointer never crosses to it, nothing is copied or sent to it, it stays paired; resume: crossing and copying work again without pairing anew.
checks.flow-hold-ctrl: Flow cross-only-with-Ctrl on, X11: pushing at the edge without Ctrl stays; with either Ctrl it crosses; letting Ctrl go mid-push stays. Wayland, where Ctrl cannot be read: it never crosses by the edge; the Flow action still works. Setting off: crossing as before.
checks.keyboard-ring-key: Actions Ring on a free programmable keyboard key: tap opens the ring at the pointer and a bubble click runs; hold, point, release runs; tap, tap closes; turning the keyboard off while held closes the ring; the mouse ring button still works; a ring key in an app profile works only in that app.
checks.fn-lock-notices: Fn-lock notices on: each Fn-lock change the keyboard reports shows one notice with the new state; off shows nothing.
checks.keyboard-key-positions: Keys page with the real keyboard: each top-row key's outline sits on the F-key that carries it; Tab, Caps Lock, Shift, Ctrl, Alt and the navigation keys sit on their own keys; a Mini is drawn with the compact layout; keys without a known place are listed under Other keys.
